formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (s : Fin n → Bool) (T' : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → s u ≠ s v) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ → PEqualNP.Core.IsLiftFixedPoint G C → (∀ k < C.gates.length, PEqualNP.Core.InOutputCone n C k) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover (G.deleteEdges (((PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.TopForm.gammaE G C) : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n))) : Set (Sym2 (Fin n)))) T' → (((PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.Core.coneSet n C)).filter (fun w => w ∈ PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C ∨ ((PEqualNP.TopForm.readers n C w).filter (fun k => PEqualNP.Core.InOutputCone n C k)) ⊆ (PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.Core.coneSet n C))).card + (G.edgeFinset \ (PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.TopForm.gammaE G C)).card + T'.card + (PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).card ≤ C.size + 1
plain_statement: G is a bipartite graph with no 4-cycle. C has AND and OR gates only, each reading exactly two earlier wires (so it reads only earlier wires), computes the edge function of G, is a lift fixed point, and every gate lies in the output's cone (no dead gates). Let U be the union of the cones of the maximal cores, U0 the gates of U that are maximal cores or are read only by gates of U (readers in the output's cone), D the edges the maximal cores accept, mc their number, tau the least vertex-cover size. Then |U0| + |E - D| + tau(G - D) + mc <= (gates of C) + 1.
title: Rest bound, live circuits: at a lift fixed point of a fan-in-two AND/OR edge circuit with no dead gate, no 4-cycle, |U0| + |E-D| + tau(G-D) + mc <= gates + 1
